gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-bitter: Commanding in the heading, grounded in the text: Dela Gothic One stands tall with its wide channels of empty space. Bitter follows with a slab-serif body whose big lowercase and open s keep the lines easy to see through.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans carries the text with minimal fuss, its strokes never changing weight. Instrument Sans against Dela Gothic One makes the strongest quality a stark split between a loud display heading and a plain sans body.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-inter: Dela Gothic One lets its body height nearly match its capitals. Inter, in a sans-serif body with tube-like smoothness and big counters, would glide down a longer page without a single stroke-weight hiccup.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-mulish: Mulish brings a large x-height and short ascenders beneath the heavy display heading. And across a longer passage its arches, as thick as the stems, would keep the lines flowing without any thick-and-thin flicker.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-poppins: Modern and clean, Poppins gives a sans-serif body of ribbon-like strokes and sturdy lowercase beneath Dela Gothic One. And over a longer stretch those loose, constant curves would read smoothly, never flickering between thick and thin.
gen-gf-dela-gothic-one-rubik: Dela Gothic One shouts from the top, with wide channels of empty space between its letters. And Rubik's big lowercase and open round shapes would keep a longer passage of sans-serif text soft and clear.
gen-gf-didact-gothic-fs-literata: Neutral and modern up top, Didact Gothic draws its line at a single width, with a g open at the bottom. Literata adds a text serif with gentle weight shifts.
gen-gf-diphylleia-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans brings sharp, refined sans-serif text with generous space between curve ends and stems. And beside Diphylleia's soft, literary tapering, a longer passage would feel crisp rather than inky.
gen-gf-dm-mono-fs-literata: Typewriter-tidy letters hang on a line in DM Mono, with no modulation at all, then Literata's classic serif slips in with gentle thick-thin shifts. The strongest quality is that stiff-versus-bookish tension.
gen-gf-donegal-one-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans sets a sharp, refined tone with generous gaps beside the stems. Donegal One does best with open mouths and tempered thick-thin transitions, while Bespoke Sans stays low in modulation and crisp in sans text.
